data: {"generalSituation":"The broad trough of low pressure now affecting the coast of Guangdong will weaken gradually today and tomorrow. The weather will become bright over the region, but there will still be showers. Tropical Cyclone Dolphin over the western North Pacific will move across the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days, and move in the general direction of the vicinity of the East China Sea in the latter part of this week. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent movement. Under the influence of the outer subsiding air of Dolphin, the weather will improve gradually over the coast of southeastern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be very hot over the weekend.
